metadata.description: Grant Isom's portable Agent Skills, also available as individually installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Walk through every open decision one at a time, three options each with one recommended, so the person deciding stays fast and in control.

plugins.name: skill-thief
plugins.description: Evaluate someone else's agent tooling, extract the mechanisms worth taking, and decide where each one lands in your own setup.

plugins.name: ux-deep-dive
plugins.description: Drive every screen of a mobile or web app, capture all of it, and hand back a pre-annotated, markup-ready UX audit: a PDF, a motion page, the raw captures, the fixture used, and the build blockers hit on the way.

plugins.name: write-like-grant
plugins.description: Write or rewrite a message in Grant Isom's personal voice: warm, upbeat, concise, and a little playful, with the formality dialed to match the reader.
